artist.name: Doe Maar
artist.summary: Dutch pop and ska band, the biggest of the early eighties

suggestions.name: Het Goede Doel
suggestions.why: Smart Dutch-language pop from the same golden years.

suggestions.name: Toontje Lager
suggestions.why: Catchy Dutch new wave with a wink.

suggestions.name: Frank Boeijen Groep
suggestions.why: Dutch-language rock with a dark, romantic edge.

suggestions.name: Golden Earring
suggestions.why: The Dutch rock band that went furthest abroad.

suggestions.name: Drukwerk
suggestions.why: Early-eighties nederpop, lighter and more playful.

suggestions.name: Klein Orkest
suggestions.why: Gentle songs with sharp, political words.

suggestions.name: The Scene
suggestions.why: Rough, poetic Dutch rock from a decade later.

suggestions.name: The Specials
suggestions.why: British two-tone ska, tight and political.
suggestions.bridge: The offbeat ska guitar of Doe Maar's early songs came from the two-tone wave The Specials started.

suggestions.name: The Police
suggestions.why: Reggae rhythms played as tight new-wave rock.
suggestions.bridge: Doe Maar mixed reggae into pop the way The Police did, and were called the Dutch answer to them.
